back: Repeating a set of statements a fixed number of times or until a condition is met.
FOR Counter ← Start TO End STEP n … NEXT Counter. Runs End − Start + 1 times when STEP is 1.
WHILE condition DO … ENDWHILE. Tested before each pass; may run 0 times; stops when FALSE.
REPEAT … UNTIL condition. Tested after each pass; runs at least once; stops when TRUE.
Known count: FOR. Might not be needed at all: WHILE. Must run at least once (validation): REPEAT.
A loop whose condition never changes inside it, e.g. a WHILE loop with no new INPUT.
The inner loop runs fully on each outer pass; total passes = outer count × inner count.
FOR Count ← 20 TO 2 STEP -6 gives 20, 14, 8, 2: the loop stops before passing the end value.
range(1, 11) gives 1 to 10: the stop value is not included. Python has no REPEAT … UNTIL.
